name: agrosmart-frontend-workspace
description: Orquestador de microfrontends de AgroSmart Insights

scripts.preview:chat: cd chat-microfrontend && npm run build && npm run preview
scripts.preview:monitoreo: cd monitoreo-microfrontend && npm run build && npm run preview
scripts.preview:mercados: cd mercados-microfrontend && npm run build && npm run preview
scripts.preview:alertas: cd alertas-microfrontend && npm run build && npm run preview
scripts.preview:calendario: cd calendario-microfrontend && npm run build && npm run preview
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix agrosmart-frontend install && npm --prefix chat-microfrontend install && npm --prefix monitoreo-microfrontend install && npm --prefix mercados-microfrontend install && npm --prefix alertas-microfrontend install && npm --prefix calendario-microfrontend install
